dialogues.speaker: Voynich Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: To promote various economic activities in Nasha Town, we of the Voynich Guild believe that it is necessary to create a platform where the vox populi may be heard in a manner both authoritative and convenient to use. To this end, we have set up this bulletin board.

dialogues.speaker: Voynich Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: Any information with potential economic value can be posted here — including but not limited to: item trades, collaboration offers, treasure clues, or even just complaints, and so on...

dialogues.speaker: Voynich Guild Announcement
dialogues.text: This board has no restrictions on content or format. Everyone is free to speak their mind. We hope you encounter endless business opportunities here!
